introHtml: Vented sweaters and cardigans offer added breathability through mesh panels or side vents, making them ideal for active work environments or fluctuating temperatures. Unlike standard knits, vented styles reduce overheating while maintaining a professional look. Decorate with embroidery or screen printing for a uniform that keeps your team comfortable and on-brand. Perfect for warehouse staff, outdoor crews, or any team needing airflow without sacrificing polish.
